decisions.reason: Its low carrying cost as an accessory and still-unresolved demand make the option worth more than the cost of keeping it.
Close to the established LED luminaire range, its results are likely positive and uncertainty is low, so it remains a valuable option.
Although the server box has higher support costs, home automation demand is still uncertain enough that the option value justifies keeping it.
As a core luminaire family close to existing products, its value is likely realized and it remains a low-risk option.
